    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 1:

            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc

                forward = 0
                rr, cc = nr + dr, nc + dc

                    forward += 1
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
                backward = 0
                rr, cc = r - dr, c - dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    backward += 1
                    rr, cc = rr - dr, cc - dc
                if forward >= backward:
                    rr, cc = nr + dr, nc + dc
                    sr, sc = dr, dc
                else:
                    rr, cc = r - dr, c - dc
                    sr, sc = -dr, -dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr, cc = rr + sr, cc + sc
